newsitem.title: UK: Air express growth means substantial investments.
newsitem.headline: Air express growth means substantial investments.

text.p: The big players in the rapidly expanding air express market are making major investments to cope with demand and customer needs and smaller operators will likely find it hard to keep up, a top industry official said.
"The difficulty for many companies trying to join the top table, is that it does not come cheaply," DHL International (UK) Ltd managing director Nick Butcher told reporters.
"We have invested many million of dollars as have our main competitors."
Apart from the DHL Worldwide Express group, the other big operators, also known as integrators, are Federal Express Corp Australian TNT Ltd group, he said.
The Dutch post office, PTT Nederland, recently gained a majority stake in the Australian firm and has said it is keen to integrate TNT into its own structure.
"All the integrators have invested heavily and have access to funds. They can build air and ground networks and spend hundreds of millions of dollars on establishing a global presence," Butcher said.
